title: Cancelling an Ordered Tire Set — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
An ordered Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty set that has not been mounted can be cancelled.

- The set must be in status ordered when it is cancelled.
- A set still ordered after the line's hold after purchase, counted from the purchase date, is cancelled by the store without a request.
- An installed set is never cancelled; it can only be returned under the satisfaction trial.

**Cancellation refund — clause no longer in force as first issued.** The clause "the refund is the pre-tax ticket total, less a restocking fee of the line's restocking percentage of the tire count times the price per tire, rounded half up to the cent; the restocking fee applies both to a customer-requested cancellation and to a hold-period lapse, and is not withheld when the line's restocking percentage is 0" is no longer in force as first issued. It holds for a customer-requested cancellation: the refund is the pre-tax ticket total less that restocking fee, rounded half up to the cent, and the fee is not withheld when the line's restocking percentage is 0. For a lapsed-order refund paid on an ordered set the store cancels because its hold period lapsed, the refund is the tire price paid less the restocking fee, less every other charge that refund's own terms state and plus every relief they give, each worked out on its own, the restocking fee less its reliefs never below 0, rounded half up to the cent.

**Customer-requested cancellation (hypothetical ticket):** a ticket total of $500.00 for 4 tires at $100.00 on a line with a 10% restocking fee refunds $500.00 less $40.00, that is $460.00; on a line with 0% nothing is withheld.

superseded_clauses: The refund is the pre-tax ticket total computed under tires_purchase_ticket, less a restocking fee of special_order_restocking_fee_pct percent of tire_count times unit_price, rounded half up to the cent; the restocking fee applies both to a customer-requested cancellation and to a hold-period lapse, and is not withheld when the line's special_order_restocking_fee_pct is 0.
